info.title: E-Commerce API
info.description: RESTful E-Commerce API built with Express.js, MongoDB, and Mongoose featuring JWT authentication, product management with image uploads, ratings, shopping cart, transactional orders, and polymorphic likes.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User registration, authentication, password management, and profile endpoints

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Product catalog, filtering, pricing analytics, image upload, and ratings

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Order placement and order history for authenticated users

bearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT token obtained from POST /api/users/signin (without the 'Bearer ' prefix in Swagger UI).

errors.description: Optional list of validation error messages

description.example: Lightweight cushioned running shoes for daily training.
Updated mesh upper for improved breathability.

id.description: ObjectId of the Product or Category to like/unlike

UnauthorizedError.description: Authentication token is missing, invalid, or expired

post.description: Creates a new Customer or Seller account with a bcrypt-hashed password.
Authenticates a user by email and password and returns a signed JWT valid for 24 hours.

get.description: Retrieves the currently authenticated user's profile.
Returns all products sorted by newest first with populated category names.

post.description: Creates a new product with an optional uploaded image (`multipart/form-data`). Comma-separated strings are accepted for `category` (Category ObjectIds) and `sizes`.

description.example: Lightweight cushioned running shoes for daily training.

get.summary: Filter products by price or category
get.description: Filters products by optional minimum price, maximum price, and category ID(s).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category ObjectId (repeat parameter for multiple categories)

get.description: Aggregates product prices to compute the average price and product count per category, sorted descending by average price.
Fetches a single product by its ID with populated categories and reviews.

put.description: Updates fields on an existing product by its ID.

delete.description: Deletes a product and cleans up its associated reviews and category references.

post.description: Creates or updates the authenticated user's rating (1 to 5) for a product.

get.description: Retrieves all items in the authenticated user's shopping cart.

post.description: Adds a product to the authenticated user's cart or increments its quantity if it already exists.

put.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item belonging to the authenticated user.

delete.description: Deletes a specific cart item belonging to the authenticated user.

post.description: Places a new order inside a MongoDB transaction from all items currently in the authenticated user's cart, then clears the cart.

get.description: Retrieves all orders placed by the authenticated user sorted by newest first.
Retrieves a specific order belonging to the authenticated user by its ID.

post.summary: Toggle like on a product or category
post.description: Likes the target Product or Category if not yet liked by the user, or removes the like if already liked.

get.summary: Get likes for a product or category
get.description: Returns all likes for a given Product or Category ID (protected by JWT middleware on the /api/likes router).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ObjectId of the Product or Category

delete.description: Removes a specific like record belonging to the authenticated user.
